composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# An Idempotency-Key naming an already-created owner replays that owner (200) instead of
# creating a duplicate; otherwise the key is published for recording and the create proceeds.
checkIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckIdempotencyKey
  govern: [ transaction ]
  outputs:
    replay: respondReplay
    proceed: validate

respondReplay:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]

validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerFields
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: validatePostcode

# Validate the optional postcode against the city's region before any downstream work, so an
# out-of-range or malformed postcode is a 400.
validatePostcode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerPostcode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: validateRegistrationDate

# Reject a supplied registration date later than the server date (a 400), before it is
# defaulted or rolled onto a business day.
validateRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateRegistrationDate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: normalizeTelephone

normalizeTelephone:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerTelephone
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: normalizeEmail

normalizeEmail:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerEmail
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: rejectDisposableEmail

# Reject a present, well-formed email whose domain is a disposable-email provider (a 400),
# after syntax has been validated and the address canonicalized.
rejectDisposableEmail:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RejectDisposableEmail
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: normalizeAddress

normalizeAddress:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerAddress
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureUniqueIdentity

# Reject a re-registration of the same identity (same telephone, email and last-name Soundex)
# as an existing, non-deleted owner (a 409). The disposable-email blocklist has already run.
ensureUniqueIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureUniqueIdentity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureCityCapacity

ensureCityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureCityCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: defaultRegistrationDate

defaultRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.DefaultRegistrationDate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: rollRegistrationDate

# Roll the effective date (supplied or defaulted) onto a business day before it drives the
# daily-limit count and the membership number's year segment.
rollRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RollRegistrationDateToBusinessDay
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureDailyLimit

ensureDailyLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureDailyLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCustomerCode

assignCustomerCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCustomerCode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: countNamesakes

countNamesakes:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CountNamesakes
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: countHousehold

countHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CountHouseholdMembers
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: capMembershipLevel

# Ceil the new owner's membership level at one above the current household maximum, before it
# is saved, so the create and later read responses report the capped level.
capMembershipLevel:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CapMembershipLevel
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: detectPossibleDuplicate

# Flag a soft duplicate (same last name + postcode, different telephone) before saving, so the
# persisted owner — and the create/read responses — carry possibleDuplicate / possibleDuplicateOf.
detectPossibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.DetectPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: recordIdempotency

# Register the saved owner under its Idempotency-Key (a no-op when none was supplied), so a
# later create repeating the key replays this owner via checkIdempotency.
recordIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RecordIdempotencyKey
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            An optional honorific for the pet owner (MR, MRS, MS or DR). When supplied it
            prefixes the derived 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 3
          example: DR
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address (e.g. street number
            and name). Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied; either form is accepted.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            An optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address (e.g. unit or
            apartment). When present it is appended to addressLine1 in the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat input for backward
            compatibility; when structured address fields are supplied it is returned as the
            composed, normalized address (normalized addressLine1, plus a space and the
            normalized addressLine2 when present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be valid for the
            city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Defaults to the current server date when not supplied.
          type: string
          format: date
